Subject: Connector blackout — need sandbox top-up and 30d trial extension

Hi Mateo,

We hit a hard stop today while wiring up your connector to our staging environment. Our engineers traced it to an intermittent handshake failure that causes the adapter to crash after ~200 requests. That put the team behind schedule and wiped out our remaining sandbox credits.

We have a demo scheduled with our ops committee in three weeks and, realistically, we need a 30-day extension on the trial plus a one-time sandbox credit top-up (~150k tokens) so we can finish the integration and validate the fix end-to-end. I attached the logs (connect_logs.zip) and included the integration team in CC.

Can you escalate for a short-term credit bump and an extension? We’ve been otherwise very impressed with the latency and cost profile — we just need a little runway to get past this blocker.

Thanks,
Alex Chen

Mateo / Ben — quick technical read: the logs show the adapter fails during the SAML assertion exchange; the connector retries until it exhausts the KV cache and then throws a fatal exception. I reproduced locally with the customer's sample payloads.

Estimate to patch and validate in staging: ~6 business days if we give the SE pair access to their staging environment and provide token throughput for smoke tests. Without direct staging access, expect ~10 business days due to back-and-forth.

Recommendation: approve a temporary 150k-token sandbox top-up (low-risk, isolated to their account) and a 30-day trial extension so they can complete end-to-end verification. I’m attaching a minimal patch (connect_patch.diff) and a short test plan.

If Ben or RevOps OK this, I’ll coordinate the patch deploy with their engineers and shadow the validation.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: connect_patch.diff (patch)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Connector blackout — need sandbox top-up and 30d trial extension

Alex — thanks for the detailed notes and logs. After reviewing the technical assessment from Marissa and confirming with RevOps, we can approve the following:

- One-time sandbox credit top-up of 150,000 tokens (applied immediately to your staging account).
- Trial period extension of 30 calendar days starting today.

Conditions: we’ll keep the top-up scoped to your trial/staging workspace only; this is a one-off support concession tied to the active deal D-48392 and the expectation that CleverForms will continue the POC. A short trial-extension agreement is attached — please sign and return at your convenience.

Next steps:
1) I’ve asked RevOps to apply the tokens now. Expect an email confirmation within the hour.
2) Marissa will coordinate the deploy and test window — Mateo, please slot a 1-hour follow-up with Alex for tomorrow.
3) Please sign the attached trial_extension_agreement.pdf so we can document the extension term.

Alex — happy to discuss on a quick call if you want.

Best,
